title: Use DOM-owned motion for radical artifact demo

sourceRefs.summary: Routes the radical artifact demo through DOM-owned fold-bundle-swap poses instead of a canvas handoff.
Asserts the radical artifact has no overlay and remains DOM-owned during the formerly flickering progress window.

verificationRecords.scope: production build with existing chunk-size warning

summary: Resolved: the radical artifact demo uses DOM-owned KaTeX clones for the 1/2-to-radical handoff because switching between live DOM and raster canvas produced visible flicker. The richer canvas fold remains deferred until it can avoid ownership seams.
